headword: {球根|きゅうこん}{植物|しょくぶつ}
reading: きゅうこんしょくぶつ

definitions.explanation: A plant that grows from an underground bulb and overwinters as the bulb stores nutrients. Typical examples include tulips, lilies, and daffodils.

examples.japanese: ⟦チューリップ→チューリップ：05487_chuurippu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{球根|きゅうこん}{植物|しょくぶつ}だ。

examples.english: If you plant the bulbs of bulb plants in autumn, they will bloom in spring.

examples.japanese: {球根|きゅうこん}{植物|しょくぶつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{地上部|ちじょうぶ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{枯|か}れて→枯れる：04589_kareru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{地中|ちちゅう}→地中：12135_chichuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{球根|きゅうこん}→球根：18744_kyuukon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{蓄|たくわ}える→蓄える：08996_takuwaeru⟧。
examples.english: Even when the above-ground parts wither, bulb plants store nutrients in the bulb underground.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{球根|きゅうこん}→球根：18744_kyuukon⟧ (bulb) and ⟦{植物|しょくぶつ}→植物：03248_shokubutsu⟧ (plant). A horticultural category covering plants that survive unfavorable seasons by storing nutrients in an underground bulb. Commonly encountered in gardening magazines, flower shops, and school science classes.

COMMON EXAMPLES:
- ⟦チューリップ→チューリップ：05487_chuurippu⟧: tulip
- ユリ: lily
- スイセン: daffodil
- ヒヤシンス: hyacinth
- スノードロップ: snowdrop

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {球根|きゅうこん}{植物|しょくぶつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧: to grow bulb plants
- {球根|きゅうこん}{植物|しょくぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{球根|きゅうこん}→球根：18744_kyuukon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{植|う}える→植える：01210_ueru⟧: to plant the bulbs of bulb plants

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{球根|きゅうこん}→球根：18744_kyuukon⟧: bulb — the storage organ itself
- {多年草|たねんそう}: perennial plant — a broader category; most bulb plants are perennials
- {宿根草|しゅっこんそう}: plant that dies back above ground but resprouts from the roots — contrasted with bulb plants by its storage strategy
